notes: Direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome124 impersonation) worked throughout, matching prior Home-Decor pass notes - no WAF/interstitial, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Castorama's Pet Care tree lives entirely under 'Jardin et terrasse' (Garden & Terrace) > 'Animalerie' (Pet Store) hub at /jardin-et-terrasse/abri-de-jardin-garage-carport-et-rangement/niche-poulailler-abri-et-nourriture-pour-animaux/cat_id_23.cat, confirmed via breadcrumb JSON-LD on every leaf page. Discovered via the homepage's embedded JSON nav/search index (contained literal strings 'Chat','Chien','Animalerie' etc.), then crawled each species hub (Chien, Chat, Rongeur, Oiseau, Animaux de la ferme) for its full cat_id_*.cat link set, plus the Animalerie hub page itself for anything not linked from a species hub. Counts read from the rendered '<N> produits' text inside <strong data-testid="product-count-label">, NOT from the i18n ICU template string ('{count, plural, one {# produit} other {# produits}}') which appears earlier in every page's translation bundle and must not be confused with the real count. One leaf (couchage-pour-chien, 'Dog Bedding') exposes a real 2-child sub-tree (Niche pour chien / Panier pour chien) via sidebar data-testid="category-link" nodes confirmed by their own breadcrumbs sitting one level below Couchage pour chien; treated as a grouping row per Rule 4 - note its own header count (836) exceeds the sum of its two children (562+6=568), meaning ~268 products in that parent listing aren't further sub-divided by the site; no dedicated URL/count exists for that remainder so it is left uncaptured (accuracy over coverage). One URL (/jardin-et-terrasse/.../jouet-et-accessoire-pour-animaux/cat_id_5510.cat) has a stale/mismatched slug - its actual rendered title and breadcrumb resolve to 'Jouets pour chat' (Cat Toys, child of Chat); used the real breadcrumb identity, not the URL slug, and recorded the discrepancy in that row's evidence. Dropped 'Couchage pour chat' (Cat Bedding) - page renders '0 produits', a genuine empty category, per Rule 4's drop-zero-qty instruction. Excluded 'Anti-rongeur' (breadcrumb resolves to Jardin et terrasse > Jardinage > ... > Produit anti-nuisibles et repulsif du jardin > Anti-rongeur - a garden pest-control/rodent-repellent category entirely outside the Animalerie tree, product titles confirm rat/mouse traps and poison bait) and 'Abeille et insecte' (bat shelters, insect hotels - garden wildlife habitat products, not pet-owner products, no pet purpose). The 'Rongeur' (Rodent/Small-pet) cage listing is not perfectly pure - product-title inspection shows it also contains a squirrel shelter, a hedgehog igloo (wild-garden items) and one dog-pen product mixed in among genuine rabbit/rodent enclosures; kept the category since the dominant, name-matching content is genuine small-pet housing, and this is PLP-level extraction (not per-product filtering) - flagged in the row's evidence for awareness. The 'Oiseau' (Bird) branch is genuinely mixed-purpose by product-title inspection: wild-garden nest boxes (mesange/rouge-gorge = wild tit/robin) sit alongside real pet bird cages ('Cage a oiseaux ... pour 3 a 4 oiseaux'), its food category mixes wild garden bird seed with caged-bird food (perruche/canari = parakeet/canary) and poultry-laying-hen feed, and its hygiene category mixes cage-bird cuttlebone/supplements with poultry anti-parasitic products - flagged every row MANUAL REVIEW rather than force a wild/pet/poultry split the site itself doesn't make. The 'Animaux de la ferme' (Farm Animals) branch (Poulailler = chicken coop/enclosures, and its hygiene category which also contains aquarium fish food - Tetra goldfish/guppy/pleco) is livestock/aquarium husbandry, not classic companion-pet care, and no policy for farm animals exists in the brief - flagged MANUAL REVIEW rather than silently included or excluded. Consumables (all *food* categories: dog/cat/rodent/bird food) flagged PET CONSUMABLE per the brief's open policy gap. No medical/veterinary-specific category was found (Soin et hygiene = general grooming/hygiene/wellness products - shampoo, brushes, anti-parasitic spray, supplements - not prescription/clinical items), so none flagged as medical. Absence check: navigated every species hub plus the top Animalerie hub directly (not site search), so this is real-navigation coverage, not a site-search false-absence case; no aquarium/fish, reptile, or horse-specific hub category exists on the site beyond the incidental fish-food SKUs noted above.
